evidence_quote: This study aimed to identify key determinants of poor medication adherence and develop a clinically applicable prediction model. A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 401 patients undergoing maintenance peritoneal dialysis in Xinjiang, China.
rationale: The study models medication nonadherence among peritoneal dialysis patients. It does not address brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
